faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Acer Aspire A314-31, A315-21, A315-33, A315-41G and A315-53. Note: most A315-56 units ship with a different battery (AP19B5K), so for that model in particular, please confirm by the part number on your old battery before ordering. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
